answer: Trigonometric functions express the relationship among the sides and angles of a triangle, in addition to describing points on circles. They allow us to find the coordinates of a point on any circle and to determine angles given points on a circle, as well as to express the ratios of the side lengths of triangles in terms of these functions [openstax_calculus_v1_p0062_s0_paragraph_0001].
raw_answer: Trigonometric functions express the relationship among the sides and angles of a triangle, in addition to describing points on circles.
